description: This file contains utility functions for handling generated output files, including reading, writing, and reporting on generated files within a build process.

methods.name: writeGeneratedOutput
methods.description: Writes generated output to a specified path if it has changed; performs a checksum comparison and can operate in check mode.

methods.name: reportGeneratedOutputCli
methods.description: Reports the status of generated output, suitable for CLI integration, indicating whether output is stale or has been written.
